title: Rachio Seasonal Adjust Disabled
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rachio:zone event=settings
| stats latest(seasonal_adjust_enabled) as seasonal_adjust_enabled by controller
| where seasonal_adjust_enabled!=1
| sort controller
description: Uses Rachio settings exports telemetry to monitor whether seasonal adjustment is still enabled in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for controllers that are no longer adapting to weather and season, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Rachio settings exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers whether seasonal adjustment is still enabled so you can spot controllers that are no longer adapting to weather and season before it becomes annoying.
